red_flags.message: Chest pain or chest pressure can be a heart attack and needs emergency care now.

response.message: What you described may be a medical emergency. This is not the place to look for options right now.
actions: Call 112 now (National emergency number (India)), or get to the nearest emergency department.
Do not wait to look up herbs or medicines, and do not change any prescribed medicine on your own.
